CREATE TABLE "public"."reels" (
  "approved_at" timestamptz(3),
  "business_id" text NOT NULL,
  "business_name" text NOT NULL,
  "caption" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "duration_seconds" int4 DEFAULT 10 NOT NULL,
  "error" text,
  "hashtags" json,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "instagram_media_id" text,
  "instruction" text,
  "language" text NOT NULL,
  "media_asset_id" text,
  "offer_text" text,
  "permalink" text,
  "price" text,
  "product_id" text,
  "product_name" text NOT NULL,
  "publish_ambiguous" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "published_at" timestamptz(3),
  "scenes" json,
  "script" text,
  "source_image_url" text NOT NULL,
  "stage" text DEFAULT 'UNDERSTANDING' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'QUEUED' NOT NULL,
  "template" text NOT NULL,
  "thumbnail_url" text,
  "tone" text DEFAULT 'elegant' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "video_stale" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "video_url" text,
  "voice_stale" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "voice_url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "reels_language_check_6bb0b07e" CHECK ("language" IN ('hi', 'mr', 'en')),
  CONSTRAINT "reels_stage_check_448ddf6a" CHECK ("stage" IN ('UNDERSTANDING', 'SCRIPT', 'VOICEOVER', 'SCENES', 'RENDERING', 'PREVIEW')),
  CONSTRAINT "reels_status_check_f1df3722" CHECK ("status" IN ('QUEUED', 'WRITING_SCRIPT', 'GENERATING_VOICE', 'RENDERING', 'READY', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'APPROVED', 'PUBLISHING', 'PUBLISHED', 'PUBLISH_FAILED')),
  CONSTRAINT "reels_template_check_4ef14015" CHECK ("template" IN ('SHOWCASE', 'NEW_ARRIVALS', 'SPECIAL_OFFER', 'MINIMAL_PREMIUM'))
)
